{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically too high when prices are rising rapidly, requiring 3-5% annualized value reduction for 30-day horizons",
    "When sentiment turns negative, model outputs must be lowered by 1-2% to account for delayed market sentiment adjustment",
    "Mean reversion bias exists with 0.5-1.0% annualized compression for horizons exceeding 14 days in stable markets",
    "Sentiment strength above 0.8 amplifies model bias by 3-5% in the sentiment's direction for first 7 days of forecast",
    "Model underestimates price pullbacks after 50+ bps daily gains, requiring 2-3% annualized adjustment for days 11-20",
    "When price volatility (18-day stdev) exceeds 0.4 on a price-percentage basis, compress all forecasts by 2-3%"
] }
